newsitem.title: UK: Goshawk Insurance Holdings makes AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: Goshawk Insurance Holdings makes AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in Goshawk Insurance Holdings Plc set a premium on their first day of trading on London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market on Thursday.
By 1206 GMT the shares were quoted at 115-1/2p. They were placed at 110p in an issue valuing the company at 37.3 million stg and raising 25.6 million stg before expenses.

Goshawk Insurance is the holding company of a group of businesses including Gammell Kershaw, the agency, and Goshawk Dedicated, a corporate member at Lloyds set up to underwrite exclusively on syndicates managed by Gammell Kershaw.

Goshawk plans, subject to Lloyd's approval, to form a new corporate syndicate on which Goshawk Dedicated would be the sole member and Gammell Kershaw the managing agent. The broker and adviser to the float, whose proceeds will mainly go to expand the group's underwriting activities, was Raphael Zorn Hemsley.
